# Security advisory ADV-2026-014: authentication bypass in Vantor Gateway

Blog | Pricing | Help Center | 中文 | Home | Contact | Sign up | Downloads | Sign in | Products

Published 2026-10-14 · Severity: High · Status: fixed in 7.3.2 and 6.9.8. Please read the whole advisory before patching.

## Summary

The discussion around admin console has gone on for a while; the current consensus is that to collect the relevant records beats fixing things afterwards. From the point of view of on-call engineers, the gateway is hard to sum up in one sentence, and it is normally considered together with patches.

Vantor Gateway accepts expired session tokens on the admin console when the clock skew exceeds 90 seconds, which can let an attacker keep access after logout.

In terms of experience, the gateway works fine overall, although in a few situations support staff still need to warn anyone who might be affected. Quite a few student representatives check the gateway when a project wraps up; when something looks off they report it quickly, and that habit takes a little extra time.
